name: human-tester
description: Human Tester acts as real end users to test websites and apps built with AI — many users at once, every page, button, sign-up, login, form, upload and search, then reports what works, what breaks and what to improve.

scripts.test:demo: node demo/server.js & sleep 1 && node bin/human-tester.js http://localhost:4321 --out reports/demo; kill %1
